name: VLC media player
description: Official VideoLAN media player for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and other supported systems. Use the platform-specific download route from VideoLAN.
license_note: VLC is free and open source; bundled codecs and third-party components may have separate licence terms. Review VideoLAN's notices.
notes: Choose the correct Windows, macOS, Linux, Android or Apple-platform download.
On phones and tablets, prefer the official app store listing linked by VideoLAN.
Do not download repackaged installers from third-party download portals.
